name: tailscale-pam
description: Connect to infrastructure over Tailscale PAM (SSH, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MS SQL, Elasticsearch, Kubernetes, RDP, and more): request just-in-time access through jitd and connect once it is approved. Credentials are injected by Tailscale PAM. The MCP server is jitd itself, on your tailnet: nothing runs locally.

jit_url.title: jitd URL
jit_url.description: Where jitd answers on your tailnet. Change it only if jitd doesn't run as the machine named jit, for example http://jit-1 or http://access. The MCP server is at <this URL>/mcp.
